CCCCV; Massa Numas, territorio Numidiae, praest. Sol. DCCXX; Massa Sulphorata, territorio Numidiae, praest. Sol. DCCXX; Massa Walzari olearia, territorio Numidiae, praest. Sol. DCCCCX. chinese_text: Ed. Duschesne, i: 175。文献列举“非洲境内”庄园及其收益如下：Mucario地区的Iuncis大庄园，800索利都（DCCC）；Captitano地区的Capsis大庄园，600索利都（DC）；Mimnense地区的Varia Sardana大庄园，500索利都（D）；Cryptalupi地区的Camaras大庄园，405索利都（CCCCV）；努米底亚的Numas大庄园，720索利都（DCCXX）；努米底亚的Sulphorata大庄园，720索利都（DCCXX）；努米底亚的Walzari产油大庄园，910索利都（DCCCCX）。关于意大利捐献及主要特征，参见D. De Francesco, ‘Le donazioni costantiniane nell’Agro Romano’, 69。

source_text: D. De Francesco, ‘Chiesa Romana e proprieta` fondiaria nel suburbio’; for an overview of the properties held by the Church of Rome in Italy, see Pietri, Roma Christiana. In North Africa a massa Candida is mentioned by Augustine (En. in Ps. 49.9; Sermo 306.2 and 311) and Prudentius (Peristephanon, 13.76–87): According to their narrative, 300 Christians were martyred there in AD 258 (also mentioned by Paulinus of Nola, Carm. 19.44, and found in an inscription found at Calama – V 2070). In this case there is no precise evidence attesting that this land belonged to the church.
chinese_text: D. De Francesco, ‘Chiesa Romana e proprietà fondiaria nel suburbio’；关于罗马教会在意大利持产的概况，参见Pietri, *Roma Christiana*。奥古斯丁（*En. in Ps.* 49.9；*Sermo* 306.2及311）与普鲁登提乌斯（*Peristephanon* 13.76–87）都提到北非Candida大庄园。根据其叙述，258年有三百名基督徒在那里殉道；诺拉的保利努斯也提到此事（*Carm.* 19.44），卡拉马发现的一篇铭文同样载有记述，V 2070。但此例没有确切证据证明该土地属于教会。

source_text: See, e.g., Council of Carthage (345–8), 6 (CSEL 149: 6); Breviarium Hipponiense 15 (CSEL 149: 38); Canones in causa Apiarii 150 (CSEL 149: 122).
chinese_text: 例如，参见迦太基会议（345—348年）第6条（CSEL 149: 6）；*Breviarium Hipponiense* 15（CSEL 149: 38）；*Canones in causa Apiarii* 150（CSEL 149: 122）。

source_text: Forty-five Catholic bishops were from Zeugitania, but with a disproportionate number of 120 from Mauretania Caesariensis, also under Vandal dominion. The persecutions were extreme in Zeugitania, while rulers in other regions were more tolerant.
chinese_text: 四十五位大公派主教来自泽乌吉塔纳，而同样受汪达尔统治的凯撒里亚毛里塔尼亚，却有不成比例的一百二十位。泽乌吉塔纳迫害极其严厉，其他地区统治者则更宽容。
